macro_summary.hormuz_vs_2022: Russia-Ukraine 2022 was sanctions/rerouting; Hormuz is a choke-point (oil + LNG) where physical disruption could be larger, but only if sustained physical disruption, not just risk premium.
macro_summary.vn_transmission_chain: oil_up_gas_up -> CPI_up + FX stress -> deposit rates up -> risk-off for rate-sensitive sectors; commodity-linked sectors may outperform (oil services, fertilizer, shipping); ports depend on volume not just freight.
macro_summary.key_caveat: Buy-the-dip only works if VN stays in liquidity/FX/rate-stable regime; otherwise dip can be start of de-rating.

Hormuz_A_RiskPremium.definition: Headline risk and war-risk premium in oil/LNG; no sustained physical disruption of transit.
Hormuz_A_RiskPremium.expected_market_behavior: Spikes in oil/LNG futures; tanker insurance and war-risk premia up; curve may backwardate briefly then ease.
vn_implications: Commodity names may rally then mean-revert if no real tightness

Hormuz_B_PartialShutdown.definition: Partial or intermittent disruption to tanker transit; some rerouting; elevated but not full closure.
Hormuz_B_PartialShutdown.expected_market_behavior: Sustained backwardation; LNG JKM/TTF elevated; shipping indices up; AIS transit proxies show reduced flows.
vn_implications: Gas input costs up for DCM/DPM
Urea ASP may pass through with lag
FX and deposit rate pressure if prolonged

Hormuz_C_FullClosure.definition: Sustained physical closure or severe blockage of Hormuz transit.
Hormuz_C_FullClosure.expected_market_behavior: Extreme backwardation; LNG spike; SPR/IEA release signals; OPEC rhetoric vs actual exports critical.
vn_implications: Winners: oil services, fertilizer if gas secured; Losers: airlines, plastics, rate-sensitive

key_indicators.name: Oil curve structure
key_indicators.why: Sustained backwardation indicates real tightness vs risk premium.
key_indicators.bearish_if: Prolonged steep backwardation with no inventory relief

key_indicators.name: Tanker insurance / war-risk premium
key_indicators.why: Proxy for market assessment of physical transit risk.

key_indicators.name: OPEC spare capacity rhetoric vs actual exports
key_indicators.why: Gap between talk and real supply.

key_indicators.name: LNG JKM / TTF spike
key_indicators.why: Gas cost driver for VN fertilizer and power.

decision_rules.rule: If monitoring suggests risk premium only (no sustained physical disruption): treat commodity rally as temporary.
If >=4/6 real-cycle signals: treat as real commodity tightness; gas/urea inputs and sector map apply.
decision_rules.notes: No allocation advice; monitor DCM/DPM calculators and sector map.

decision_rules.rule: If VN liquidity/FX/rates deteriorate: buy-the-dip invalid; de-rating risk for rate-sensitive names.

winners.mechanism: Higher oil/gas activity and day-rates; upstream capex proxy.
Urea/gas cost pass-through; export and domestic ASP.
invalidation_triggers: Gas cost spike without ASP pass-through
Hormuz full closure rerouting away from VN-relevant routes

winners.mechanism: Optional relative beneficiary if gas/oil substitute.

losers.mechanism: Deposit rates up if CPI/FX stress.

mixed.mechanism: Volume vs cost; depends on trade flows.

agri_commodity_map.thesis: VN is net importer of wheat/soy/corn; default impact negative via feed cost inflation.

winners: Limited domestically; VN not major exporter of these grains.
losers: Food processors with weak pricing power

price_triggers.level_2: +10% over 8 weeks; margin risk; if corn or soymeal Level2 and USDVND up then margin squeeze risk activated.

variables: Futures curve structure (sustained backwardation = real tightness)
Export pace / shipment disruptions (real, not just headlines)
Cross-commodity confirmation (soy oil vs soymeal; corn/ethanol link; wheat supply)
